description: Presidential Secretariat - Enlarging the period of time of Presidential Commission of Inquiry for rendition of the final report on Bomb Explotion occurred on 21st April, 2019.
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the extension of a commission's reporting period under the Commission of Inquiry Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It deals with statutory powers, legal timelines, and procedural extensions rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any of the other specialized categories.
